ask: A woman films herself opening a water bottle and drinking, 8 seconds, phone selfie.

clip.objective: a believable, unforced moment: she opens the bottle and drinks, nothing performed
clip.dramatic_function: small everyday relief; the drink is the payoff of the open

pass_plan.reason: no research; reasoned: no environment reaction beyond the bottle itself
no research; reasoned: seated upper-body action fully described by the interaction stages
actor touches a bottle and its cap
a contact (twist) with a stated reaction (cap comes free, water moves)
no research; reasoned: one actor, one object, fixed camera
bottle, cap and water level persist across beats
a living performer is on screen
no research; reasoned: nothing is withheld or revealed
no research; reasoned: available flat light stated in the capture texture
a real phone look is implied by 'films herself'
no research; model audio support unknown; no dialogue asked

entities.description: A woman in her late twenties with her hair tied back, in a plain T-shirt, sitting at a kitchen table
entities.short: A woman, hair tied back, plain T-shirt, at a kitchen table

entities.description: A clear plastic water bottle with a white screw cap, label facing the camera, water about two-thirds full
entities.short: A clear plastic water bottle, white screw cap, label to camera

entities.description: Her phone is propped against a mug on the table, front camera facing her, so both hands are free
entities.short: Her phone is propped against a mug, front camera on her, both hands free

stages.description: bottle sealed on the table; phone propped; both hands free
small breath; gaze drops to the bottle; hands move toward it
left hand wraps the body in a full grip; right thumb and index pinch the cap
one short counter-clockwise twist; the cap turns, the body stays still

stages.reaction: the cap comes free with a small click and lifts away in her right fingers; the bottle mouth is open; a faint ripple runs through the water

stages.description: right hand lifts the cap clear, still pinched
left hand raises the open bottle; right hand lowers the cap toward the table edge
bottle open in the left hand, cap visible in the right
bottle rises toward her mouth; eyes glance down to it

stages.reaction: her throat moves with two swallows; the water level tilts and drops a little

stages.description: she lowers the bottle; a small exhale
settle; glance back to the lens

beats.label: settle in
beats.description: She leans slightly into frame and glances at the lens; the sealed bottle stands on the table in front of her
beats.short: she leans in and glances at the lens; the sealed bottle sits in front of her
beats.key_pose: head and shoulders centred, bottle visible lower frame

beats.label: reach and grip
beats.description: After a small breath she reaches down; her left hand wraps the bottle body and her right thumb and index finger pinch the cap
beats.short: she reaches down; left hand wraps the bottle, right fingers pinch the cap

beats.label: twist
beats.description: She gives the cap one short counter-clockwise twist; the cap turns while the bottle stays still
beats.short: one short counter-clockwise twist; the cap turns, the bottle stays still

beats.label: cap comes free
beats.description: The cap comes free with a small click and lifts away in her right fingers; the bottle mouth is open and a faint ripple runs through the water
beats.short: the cap comes free with a click and lifts in her fingers; the water ripples

beats.label: raise
beats.description: She raises the open bottle with her left hand, eyes dropping to it, and lowers the cap toward the table edge with her right
beats.short: she raises the open bottle, eyes on it, cap lowered in her right hand

beats.label: drink
beats.description: The rim meets her lips, she tilts the bottle and takes two swallows; her throat moves and the water level drops a little
beats.short: rim to lips, two swallows; the water level drops

beats.label: lower and settle
beats.description: She lowers the bottle, exhales softly and glances back at the lens with a faint satisfied look, then holds still
beats.short: she lowers the bottle, exhales, glances to the lens and holds still
beats.min_s_origin: PROJECT_DERIVED convention (settle; end on a hold)
beats.key_pose: bottle lowered, cap in right hand, eyes to lens

controls.value: An 8-second vertical phone selfie clip, one continuous take, no cuts

controls.expected_visual_effect: left hand wraps the body; right thumb and index pinch and turn the cap; cap rotates, body still
controls.check: cap rotates while bottle body stays still; five fingers each hand

value.chain: grip, one twist, cap free, lift, drink

controls.expected_visual_effect: cap is attached until after the twist; drink only after the open
controls.check: frame order: grip before twist, twist before cap off, cap off before drink

controls.value: The twist has a visible result: the cap releases with a small click, lifts clear in her fingers, and the water inside ripples once
controls.expected_visual_effect: cap separation is a distinct moment with a reaction
controls.check: cap separation visible as its own frame range

value.items: the bottle keeps its size, shape, colour and readable label; the cap stays in her right fingers after it comes off and never reattaches or vanishes; the water level only drops when she drinks
value.items_short: the bottle keeps its size, label and colour; the cap stays in her fingers; the water only drops as she drinks

controls.expected_visual_effect: same bottle every frame; cap visible after removal
controls.check: bottle scale and label constant; cap present after b4

value.register: casual and unforced, like a friend on a call

controls.expected_visual_effect: light, unhurried, direct movements; relaxed grip; alive face without a held smile
controls.check: no locked stare; at least one blink and one glance away

value.motion: the phone is propped and static, with a faint settle in the first moment and no movement after
value.optics: wide front camera at arm's length, about 24 mm equivalent, mild barrel distortion, deep focus with everything sharp
value.framing: medium close-up, head and shoulders, slightly below eye level; the bottle enters from the bottom of the frame

controls.expected_visual_effect: static vertical selfie framing, wide lens look, deep focus
controls.check: no camera motion after the first second; no bokeh

controls.expected_visual_effect: reads as real phone footage; visible skin texture; no grade
controls.check: no bokeh, no cinematic grade, skin not waxy

controls.expected_visual_effect: actions read one at a time; clip ends on a held settle
controls.check: no overlapping actions; last half second still

controls.expected_visual_effect: none of the listed failures appear

notes: Phone propped (decision d001) so both hands are free for a screw cap; a handheld variant would need a one-hand opening treatment.
